blocks.text: Nikita Shabalin specializes in real estate, construction and hospitality. He particularly focuses on advising on various complex issues of civil, land and urban planning legislation.

blocks.text: Nikita has solid experience advising on real estate transactions, including asset deals, leases, investments, management agreements, etc. He is also frequently involved in comprehensive legal due diligence of real estate properties and companies whose main assets are real estate properties, as well as construction projects at any stage of development. Nikita is also experienced advising on real estate litigation matters, urban planning and other regulatory issues.
